title: Demystifying When and Why VLAs Fail in Contact-Rich Tasks and How to Fix Them
abstract: arXiv:2608.01402v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We address the problem of understanding when and why Vision-Language-Action models struggle with contact-rich manipulation tasks that require precise physical interaction. Prior work has primarily focused on addressing contact failures through force-augmented architectures and training-time regularizers, yet the factors contributing to these failures remain underexplored. We identify two distinct failure modes underlying this gap. Precision failures occur when policies struggle to produce the small, accurate corrective actions required during contact and force failures occur when policies fail to respond to contact forces. To address these failures, we propose FACT. During post-training, FACT increases low noise sampling to improve fine action prediction and incorporates structured force conditioning to guide action generation using contact state and force history. translated_title: 揭秘VLA（视觉-语言-动作）模型在富接触任务中何时、为何失败以及如何修复
translated_abstract: 我们致力于理解视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在需要精确物理交互的富接触操作任务中何时以及为何表现不佳这一问题。先前的工作主要通过力增强架构和训练时正则化器来解决接触失败问题，然而导致这些失败的因素仍未得到充分探索。我们识别出造成这一差距的两种不同的失败模式：精度失败发生在策略难以产生接触过程中所需的小而准确的修正动作时，而力失败发生在策略未能对接触力做出响应时。为了解决这些失败，我们提出了FACT。在后训练阶段，FACT增加低噪声采样以改进精细动作预测，并引入结构化力条件机制，利用接触状态和力历史来引导动作生成。FACT在五个接触任务上取得了平均66%的成功率。
tldr: 该论文揭示了VLA模型在富接触任务中的两种失败模式（精度失败与力失败），并提出FACT方法，通过后训练阶段的低噪声采样和结构化力条件机制将平均成功率提升至66%。
